scope: Packaged local MinIO/PostgreSQL/Redis/Celery recovery; small deterministic fixtures; no live AWS, concurrency or large-file measurement

cases.name: Upload initiation commits, response is lost
cases.recovery_clock: Injected fault observed to READY observed in browser; includes retries or explicit original-file reselection.

cases.name: Part-signing transaction commits, response is lost
cases.recovery_clock: Injected fault observed to READY observed in browser; includes retries or explicit original-file reselection.

cases.name: Storage PUT interrupted before accepting the complete part
cases.recovery_clock: Injected fault observed to READY observed in browser; includes retries or explicit original-file reselection.

fault.kind: real truncated storage PUT plus browser transport failure

cases.name: Storage accepts PUT, its response is lost
cases.recovery_clock: Injected fault observed to READY observed in browser; includes retries or explicit original-file reselection.

cases.name: Acknowledgement request is lost before reaching API
cases.recovery_clock: Injected fault observed to READY observed in browser; includes retries or explicit original-file reselection.

cases.name: Acknowledgement commits, its response is lost
cases.recovery_clock: Injected fault observed to READY observed in browser; includes retries or explicit original-file reselection.

cases.name: Browser reload after several acknowledged parts
cases.recovery_clock: Original-file reselection requested after reload/pause to READY observed in browser; includes resume hashing and excludes deliberate interruption hold.

fault.kind: real browser reload after durable acknowledgements

cases.name: User pause while parts are in flight
cases.recovery_clock: Original-file reselection requested after reload/pause to READY observed in browser; includes resume hashing and excludes deliberate interruption hold.

fault.kind: user pause during real storage PUTs throttled by Chrome DevTools

cases.name: Part URL expires before PUT
cases.recovery_clock: First actual expired-signature HTTP 403 observed to READY observed in browser; includes URL renewal and transfer.

fault.kind: genuinely expired signed URL rejected by MinIO

cases.title: API killed during incomplete multipart upload
cases.recovery_clock_definition: Restoration request (before Docker start or HTTP completion retry) to API READY observation; R18 begins after confirmed worker death and includes the natural lease wait. The separately labelled post-restoration sequence observation excludes startup/readiness probes.
